children: Sweden air traffic management tech firm's preliminary Q3 net sales fell 16% yr/yr, due to lower utilization by a major customer
Net earnings for preliminary Q3 declined 40% yr/yr, impacted by lower revenue and investments
Company's preliminary Q3 cash flow improved, aided by EU grants and overdue customer payments
Company says timing of customer decisions remains difficult to predict
Company reports a broader and more active commercial pipeline entering 2027
MAJOR CUSTOMER UTILIZATION - Co said lower utilization by a major customer drove declines in recurring revenue
INVESTMENTS IMPACT - Co said planned investments in sales, onboarding and product development weighed on net earnings
EU GRANTS AND PAYMENTS - Co said improved cash flow was aided by EU project grants and overdue customer payments
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Avtech Sweden AB (publ) is SEK6.60, about 112.2% above its October 12 closing price of SEK3.11
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
